results.request: I need a CRM app for my company.
results.reasoning: A CRM is a single cohesive domain covering contacts, companies, deals, and activities; there is no indication of separate team ownership or distinct domains that would justify splitting into multiple apps.
questions: Is this primarily B2B (selling to companies with multiple contacts) or B2C (individual consumers)?
Do you need a sales pipeline/deal tracking (e.g., stages like Lead → Qualified → Proposal → Won), or is this mainly a contact/activity log?

Do you need integration with external systems such as email (Gmail/Outlook), calendar, marketing tools, or an existing ERP/accounting system?
Roughly how many users and contacts/deals are you managing — tens, hundreds, or thousands?

results.request: We need a simple employee directory with departments, roles, locations, and emergency contacts.
results.reasoning: This is a single cohesive app — all requested entities (departments, roles, locations, emergency contacts) are tightly coupled to the employee record and would be owned by one team (HR/People Ops).
questions: Who should be able to view vs. edit employee records — all employees read-only, with HR/admins able to edit?
Should emergency contacts be visible to everyone or restricted to HR/managers only?
Is there an org-chart / reporting-line hierarchy needed (i.e., employees reporting to a manager)?
Should this integrate with any existing HR system or identity provider (e.g., Azure AD, Workday) for data sync?

results.request: Build us a vacation request tool where employees can request time off and managers approve it.
results.reasoning: This is a single-domain HR workflow with one approval chain—employees and managers operate within the same tool, so one app with a few entities is the right scope.
questions: Do you need to track PTO balances (accruals, carryover, caps), or is this purely request-and-approve without balance enforcement?
Is approval a single-manager step, or do you need multi-level / multi-approver workflows (e.g., direct manager then HR)?
Should this integrate with an external calendar or HRIS system (e.g., Outlook, Google Calendar, Workday, BambooHR)?
Do you need a team leave calendar / conflict-detection so managers can see overlapping absences before approving?
Are there external or non-employee users (e.g., contractors submitting requests) who need access?

results.request: We need an onboarding checklist app for new hires with tasks for HR, IT, and managers.
results.reasoning: This is a single app: HR, IT, and manager tasks all belong to one onboarding workflow, not separate domains owned by different teams.
questions: Are onboarding checklists templated per role/department and auto-assigned, or manually created per new hire?
Do new hires themselves complete any tasks (self-service portal), or is the app used only by HR/IT/managers?
Are there task dependencies (e.g., IT can't create accounts until HR submits start date), or are all tasks independent?
Do tasks require approvals or sign-offs beyond simple completion (e.g., manager confirms equipment received)?
Do you need integration with an existing HRIS or ITSM system, or is this a standalone workflow?

results.request: We want an employee satisfaction tool that connects to Slack and asks monthly questions.
results.reasoning: This is a single cohesive domain — pulse surveys via Slack — with no indication of separate team ownership or distinct sub-systems that would justify splitting into multiple apps.
